task: Make event-type and entity-type filter dropdowns domain-dependent on the Activity Events page

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: Filter inter-dependency state management (domain drives event/entity type options; stale selections must be cleared on domain change)
technical_risk.mitigation: Pure utility functions with no side effects; revalidation logic isolated in activityEventsFilters.ts and driven by a dedicated useEffect; unit-tested

key_reasoning.reason: Change is confined to a single page component, one new pure-utility module, and a type extension — no cross-component or cross-subsystem impact

The inter-dependent filter state (domain selection clearing stale event/entity-type selections) required a dedicated revalidation effect, which is slightly beyond a trivial copy-and-adapt; however the logic is fully isolated in a tested utility and all patterns (Valtio useSnapshot, useMemo, useEffect) already existed in the codebase
